title: No eligible citizen is left out (?): Uttar Pradesh
shows: Aman Bhargava of Diagram Chasing reads Uttar Pradesh's rolls, as digitised by s1d labs, against the Chief Electoral Officer's totals, constituency by constituency. In a section on who was left off the draft of January 2026 he finds that women under 35 were left off at twice the rate of men, 2.3 times at ages 25 to 29, and that the rates for women and men match from age 55 onward. Among electors aged 19 to 34, 15.0 per cent of women and 4.6 per cent of men were marked shifted. He counts 5.9 lakh more men than women aged 18 to 24 added on the final roll, which he says widened the gap under 35, and women per 1,000 men falling from 878 on the 2024 roll to 836 on the final roll, and by 122 among electors under 25. He finds 38 per cent of registered transgender electors 'removed', in the page's word, against 23 per cent of men and women, and a higher rate for them in 316 of 386 constituencies. He also finds that women were 62 per cent of the electors stamped disqualified on the final roll. The page also counts errors on the final roll, among them a word in place of a house number in 7,18,970 entries and a relative's name printed twice in 2,13,720, and says that some mistakes may have come in through character recognition and that every example it shows and a random sample of each kind were checked by hand against the original documents. Its counts are its own, from the digitised rolls.
quote: Women under 35 were removed at twice the rate of men
Under 35, women were three times as likely to be marked shifted
note: First reading, 25 November 2026, of the page as rendered in a browser on 25 November (the 'Who was removed' section is drawn by script and does not appear in the HTML alone). The page says it was updated on 24 November 2026, and Aman Bhargava posted a thread of its counts on X on 24 November, quoting the s1d labs post that announced the digitised rolls. Its structured data gives a first date of 12 November 2026. Its methodology lists the 2024 roll, the lists of names left off the draft (ASDDR) from the Commission and the CEO as compiled by Diagram Chasing, the draft roll, the final roll and the 2027 draft from the Commission, the CEO's totals via Business Standard and News On Air, rolls digitised by s1d labs and boundaries from DataMeet. Its headline totals equal the CEO's figures in data/india/states.json (15.44 crore before, 2.89 crore left off, 13.40 crore final, a net fall of 2.04 crore). Its 23 per cent of men and women 'removed', set beside the transgender figure, is its own measure, the page does not state its base, and it differs from the CEO's 18.7 per 100 left off the draft, so the summary gives that comparison in the page's word. The words 'removed' and 'struck off' are the page's own, and the summary gives these electors as left off the draft. The page states no reason for the gap among young women. Diagram Chasing's Karnataka piece is in round 43.
